messages:
Mike (Support): FYI customer acct-555 opened a sev about 429s for bulk inference, but their Quota panel shows 0 events and normal usage. They're seeing errors since ~09:10 UTC. link: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/quotas?customer=acct-555
Tara (Oncall): can you paste a raw API response + headers if you have one? also need the request id/time
Mike (Support): here you go:
```
> curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:03 GMT
x-request-id: rq_abc123def
x-rate-limit-group: default
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 162
{"error":"rate_limited","message":"Request exceeded configured rate limit"}
```
Mike (Support): customer also sent a second id rq_abc124 at 09:14 UTC where response headers include x-quota-remaining:0
Lee (Eng-Infra): thanks — can you drop those rq ids + exact timestamps here and I'll grep enforcement logs. also which region?
Mike (Support): region=us-west-2. ids: rq_abc123def (09:12:03), rq_abc124ghi (09:14:09). customer says console shows "No quota breach events" for that window.
Lee (Eng-Infra): checking enforcement service... one sec.
OpsBot: alert: quota-writer-replay job failed 2026-04-14T08:58:00Z -> reason: redis stream timeout. ticket #INC-4217
Lee (Eng-Infra): looks like enforcement emitted the 429s — I see token-bucket hits in enforcement logs for acct-555 at those timestamps. but the metric-writer that ingests enforcement events into the dashboard has a backlog and the writer job restarted and dropped a batch earlier this morning. that would explain missing dashboard rows.
Zane (Product): was there a deploy or config change to writer around that time?
Lee (Eng-Infra): no config change. the job hit a transient Redis timeout; crashLoop restarted writer, and we lost ~1.5k events in that stream window because the replay cursor wasn't persisted.
Tara (Oncall): can we reconcile counts for the customer and backfill the dashboard ASAP? customer-facing ticket needs an ETA.
Lee (Eng-Infra): plan: 1) re-run writer in replay mode for stream shard 7 (contains acct-555) — should re-ingest events, 2) if replay fails, run ad-hoc export from enforcement logs and call /internal/metrics/ingest with that payload. I'll start replay now.
Mike (Support): shared steps with customer so they know we're on it. asked for permission to bump quota temporarily if they want immediate relief.
Zane (Product): +1 on temporary bump while we reconcile. low-risk change. can you do a one-off increase for acct-555 to avoid more 429s?
Tara (Oncall): I can patch a transient +50% burst for 30m. doing now.
OpsBot: action: quota change applied acct-555 by Tara (Oncall) — +50% burst until 2026-04-14T09:50:00Z
Mike (Support): customer confirmed fewer 429s after patch but still saw a couple — probably in-flight requests. they want a written postmortem and timeline.
Lee (Eng-Infra): replay kicked off and shows ~2k events reprocessed for shard 7. writer acked events up to 09:20 UTC. dashboard should reflect breaches in ~5–7m once pipeline flushes.
Mike (Support): noted, I'll follow up with customer and keep ticket open. any permanent remediation?
Zane (Product): long-term: make replay cursor durable on commit and add alert when writer restarts without cursor progress. also add test coverage for redis timeouts.
Lee (Eng-Infra): agreed. I'll file ENG-PLAT-789 and assign.
Tara (Oncall): closing loop: will escalate if replay doesn't fix counts by 09:30 UTC.
Mike (Support): thanks all — I'll update the customer thread after 09:25 UTC with console screenshot and final counts. :thumbsup:
